title: Umbrellas, baskets and the Grand Marshal's streamer
summary: Paper umbrellas with streamers, baskets of flowers and cigars, and how the Grand Marshal dressed differently.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

Oh, yeah, like umbrellas. Paper umbrellas, you know what I mean? Paper umbrellas.

Well, it would be all different colors, Japanese, like a Japanese design, you know what I mean?
